plan: Six bodies built for a Psychic gym. Dark and Steel typing means most of the gym's STAB is resisted or void: Incineroar, Urshifu and Gholdengo all ignore or resist the Psychic lane. Urshifu's Unseen Fist is the answer to a gym where every authored set carries Protect, and Wicked Blow's guaranteed critical ignores Calm Mind, Iron Defense, Commander and every other boost the rooms set up. Knock Off on Incineroar is the crack line for Macey's five Eviolites. Flutter Mane and Gholdengo supply two spread moves for Disguise, Illusion and Focus Sash boards. Mega Metagross is the physical win condition whose Steel typing resists the gym's whole type. Amoonguss carries Spore and Rage Powder for redirection and to punish the slow setup rooms.
